web-ui-e2e.label: Web UI and end-to-end
web-ui-e2e.description: Browser-led journeys across commerce, HR and banking systems.

api-bdd-protocols.label: APIs, BDD and real-time protocols
api-bdd-protocols.description: Contract, behaviour and live-protocol checks below the browser UI.

multi-stack-frameworks.label: Multi-stack and framework design
multi-stack-frameworks.description: Portable suites and framework internals that make automation design explicit.

mobile-products.label: Mobile and shipped products
mobile-products.description: Touch-first automation and complete browser products delivered for direct use.

security-dast.label: Security and DAST
security-dast.description: Dynamic application security testing against intentionally-vulnerable targets.

magento-checkout-automation.title: Magento Checkout Automation
magento-checkout-automation.summary: Guest-checkout journeys against Magento 2 with Serenity/JS Screenplay, profile-driven scenarios and store-safe smoke tags. Published reports record earlier runs; workflow badges show current CI status.

orangehrm-pim-automation.title: OrangeHRM PIM Automation
orangehrm-pim-automation.summary: Add-employee journeys through OrangeHRM PIM using Serenity/JS and Playwright against a Dockerised, seeded instance. Published Serenity reports provide run evidence; the November review records remaining limitations.

parabank-bank-automation.title: ParaBank Bank Automation
parabank-bank-automation.summary: Docker-backed banking automation combining Serenity/JS and Playwright UI journeys, stateful API BDD, live OpenAPI validation and REST–SOAP parity. Alternative Playwright test styles and a non-blocking k6 smoke lane broaden the teaching examples.

bfx-ws-screenplay.title: Bitfinex WebSocket Screenplay
bfx-ws-screenplay.summary: Exercises the live Bitfinex public WebSocket API v2 through an in-house Screenplay layer, including CRC-32 order-book checksum checks and bounded replay diagnostics. An intermittent checksum discrepancy remains under investigation.

hand-baked-screenplay-pattern.title: Hand-Baked Screenplay Pattern
hand-baked-screenplay-pattern.summary: A dependency-free TypeScript Screenplay teaching library: actors, abilities, tasks and questions, plus a static HTML event-fold reporter. Release 0.3.0 supplies provider and conformance seams; Stryker reports mutation scores without a blocking score threshold.

markdown-renderer.title: Markdown Renderer
markdown-renderer.summary: A static, offline Markdown viewer with folder navigation, vendored dependencies and sanitised rendering. Vitest and Playwright cover its own product behaviour, including keyboard and accessibility checks.

mobile-forex-automation.title: Mobile Forex Automation
mobile-forex-automation.summary: A responsive forex demo with a deterministic seeded price feed, exercised through Playwright Pixel 7 and iPhone 14 browser emulation. Screenplay journeys check prices, P&L, touch interaction, breakpoints and overflow.

calculator-screenplay-bdd.title: Calculator Screenplay BDD
calculator-screenplay-bdd.summary: A compact calculator with domain, REST and browser tests, an OpenAPI contract and playwright-bdd Screenplay scenarios. A versioned provider boundary supports bounded conformance checks against a second adapter.

gb.automation.smoketests.sudoku.poc.title: Sudoku Multi-Stack Parity POC
gb.automation.smoketests.sudoku.poc.summary: A common 55-scenario Sudoku contract implemented in TypeScript/Cucumber.js, Python/pytest-bdd and C#/Reqnroll. Source and execution checks compare the stacks; the November reviews document assertion, dependency-policy and evidence limitations.

portfolio-prompts.title: portfolio-prompts
portfolio-prompts.summary: provides the registry, lifecycle prompts and evidence tooling behind this workflow, including code reviews, handovers and worklists. Its public review index preserves dated assessments and parallel reviews.

juice-shop-dast-automation.title: OWASP Juice Shop DAST
juice-shop-dast-automation.summary: OWASP ZAP passive scanning and separately controlled BDD exploit-confirmation scenarios against a pinned, intentionally vulnerable Juice Shop training target. Its gate checks expected vulnerability detection.

auth-separation.title: auth-separation
auth-separation.summary: defines technology-agnostic authentication, authorisation and user-information services through OpenAPI, AsyncAPI and Gherkin specifications. Generated service skeletons return 501 responses; they demonstrate contract generation rather than implemented authentication behaviour.

auth-separation-screenplay-poc.title: Auth Separation Screenplay POC
auth-separation-screenplay-poc.summary: Exercises separated authentication, authorisation and profile APIs across Node.js, Python FastAPI and C# .NET 9. Shared Gherkin, Screenplay and OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contracts demonstrate interchangeability within the POC’s tested behaviours.

tradeblotter-wpf-screenplay.title: TradeBlotter WPF
tradeblotter-wpf-screenplay.summary: A C#/.NET 9 WPF trading blotter automated through a vendor-neutral driver contract with FlaUI.UIA3 and WinAppDriver adapters, a C# Screenplay core and Reqnroll scenarios, gated by Windows-hosted CI. Parked at TB-08B until a licensed Ranorex SDK is available.

saleor-graphql-automation.title: Saleor GraphQL Automation
saleor-graphql-automation.summary: Catalogue, authentication, checkout and staff fulfilment journeys with typed Screenplay tasks, published Serenity reports and daily upstream schema checks. Delivery is complete; dependency maintenance remains tracked. Deterministic reports are separate from live-SUT acceptance.

loan-origination-parity.title: Loan Origination Parity
loan-origination-parity.summary: One UK loan-origination engine exercised through an in-memory core, Node REST API, Angular SPA and Next.js backend-for-frontend by a shared Serenity/JS Screenplay harness. Gates compare executed scenario counts and step text; dedicated checks exercise server-side authorisation.

credit-dashboard-sut.title: Credit Dashboard SUT
credit-dashboard-sut.summary: A fictional UK credit-health dashboard built specification first: an ASP.NET Core API and React UI share contract-validated Serenity/JS scenarios, with seeded-defect, accessibility and visual checks. Delivery closed on 23 October 2026 with recorded residual limits; independent November reviews remain available.
